description: This file provides CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for managing test case data within a testing management system. It includes functions to get, create, delete test cases, and handle bulk creation, interfacing with SQLAlchemy ORM models and schemas.

methods.name: Optional[TestCase] get_testcase(db: Session, testcase_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieve a test case by its ID from the database.

methods.name: List[TestCase] get_testcases_by_file(db: Session, test_file_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieve all test cases associated with a specific test file.

methods.name: TestCase create_testcase(db: Session, testcase: TestCaseCreate)
methods.description: Create and add a new test case to the database.

methods.name: List[TestCase] create_testcases_bulk(db: Session, testcases: List[dict], test_file_id: int)
methods.description: Create multiple test cases in bulk for a given test file.

methods.name: bool delete_testcase(db: Session, testcase_id: int)
methods.description: Delete a test case by its ID from the database.

ctags.name: create_testcases_bulk
ctags.pattern: /^def create_testcases_bulk(db: Session, testcases: List[dict], test_file_id: int) -> List[TestCas/
